prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed web background for a children's career exploration progress center
Primary request: Create an original premium cinematic 3D family-animation scene of a magical sky observatory terrace overlooking six distant floating career islands connected by glowing starlight paths. The terrace has warm brass navigation instruments, carved stone railings, tiny lanterns, soft clouds, and a grand sense of discovery. This is the progress hub where a child sees which islands have been illuminated.
Style/medium: polished original stylized 3D animated-feature concept art, tactile miniature-world detail, expressive shapes, warm family-film craftsmanship, without copying any existing franchise, studio character, or copyrighted design.
Composition/framing: 16:9 wide landscape, full-bleed. Keep the central 65% relatively calm and darker navy-to-twilight blue so cream interface panels remain highly legible; place detailed observatory architecture mainly along the left and right edges and lower foreground; distant islands visible in the upper half; strong depth, no giant central object.
Lighting/mood: golden sunrise meeting deep blue twilight, magical but calm, welcoming and triumphant.
Color palette: deep indigo and ocean blue, warm amber and starlight gold, restrained coral accents, cream clouds.
Materials/textures: burnished brass, carved stone, soft volumetric clouds, glossy miniature water, warm lantern glass.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no UI panels, no real people, no recognizable copyrighted characters, no empty white background. Suitable behind a long scrolling responsive web page.
